proposal.hypothesis: A signed AVX-512 minimum reduction should reduce the loop-carried work of the baseline scan. A second pass uses equality masks and the lowest set lane to preserve earliest-index ties, with a scalar tail for incomplete vectors. This adds memory traffic: random inputs can require a substantial second scan, and decreasing inputs can require nearly a full second pass, so performance remains uncertain.

retained: Compute the signed int32 minimum with AVX512F vector minimum operations, then reduce the vector lanes and handle the first-pass scalar tail.
Scan from index zero using AVX512F equality masks; choose the lowest matching lane and use scalar search for the tail.
